description.good: A short straight run up the expressway to learn the ropes. Keep to your side, go round the barriers, and pick up the cash lying in rows.
description.evil: Two kilometres of commuters who have never met you. Introduce yourself with something on fire, and take the cash on the way through.

description.good: A short hop out past the city limits. One exit round the slow traffic and back on again: signal early, smile often, and the tip is yours.
description.evil: Quiet roads, slow vans, and nobody watching but the odd patrol car. Ideal conditions for a bad influence.

description.good: Fresh air and country lanes. Give the cows room, be patient behind the tractors, and go round the hay bales, not through them.
description.evil: Cows wander, tractors crawl and hay bales sit there asking for it. The countryside has never been delivered to this rudely.

description.good: One way through downtown, with turbos lined up like parking meters. Stay smooth, take the exit round the jam, and bank the cash.
description.evil: Everyone is going your way, so everyone is in your way. A dozen turbos say you go through them.

description.good: The beach road in a hurricane. Deck chairs, umbrellas and coolers slide across the lanes: watch where they are going and deliver dry.
description.evil: A hurricane is throwing the beach at the road and cars through the air. For once you are not the worst thing out here. Fix that.

description.good: A late delivery under the street lights. Lowriders cruise and a police chase may come through: headlights on, eyes up, parcel safe.
description.evil: A dark road, slow lowriders, and a getaway car screaming past with the law behind it. Nobody will notice one more troublemaker.

description.good: Nine mystery boxes between the cows and the tractors. We cannot say what is in them. Please collect responsibly, and mind the roaming junk.
description.evil: Nine mystery boxes: toads, earthquakes, air strikes, who knows. Grab every one and let the meadow sort itself out.

description.good: School-run country. Pull over for the ambulances, pick the bonus clocks and leave the penalty ones, and merge politely where the lanes close.
description.evil: Quiet streets, tidy lawns, SUVs with nowhere to be. Race the ambulance, grab the bonus seconds and wake the whole neighbourhood.

description.good: The capital's grand avenues, with a median to keep things civil. A bullet train shares the route: do look both ways.
description.evil: Wide avenues, slow public servants and a bullet train that takes no prisoners. Be on the right side of it and enjoy the view.

description.good: A winter stage through the snow. Ice patches on the road and cars parked along it: gentle hands, early braking, warm delivery.
description.evil: Snow, sheet ice and a row of parked cars that somebody loves. Slide wide, borrow the whole road and blame the conditions.

description.good: City streets, driving on the left. Ten junctions turn the route this way and that: follow the chevrons and wait your turn at the box.
description.evil: Ten junctions full of taxis waiting their turn. You are not waiting for yours. Keep left, mostly.

description.good: The Lion City after dark: more junctions, two bridges and boy racers sitting on your bumper. Let them by and keep the parcel level.
description.evil: Neon, bridges and boy racers who think this is their street. Show them whose it is, one flaming parcel at a time.

description.good: Ten kilometres down the coast from Sydney to Kiama: city, bush, the Sea Cliff Bridge. Watch for kangaroos, drop bears and gusts off the sea.
description.evil: A long coast road with caravans to bully, kangaroos to dodge and a cliff bridge in a crosswind. Scenic route, antisocial driver.

description.good: A causeway the sea covers twice a day, and the tide is coming in. Cross the Gois before the waves do, and keep to the dry lanes.
description.evil: The tide is swallowing the causeway and the tourists are dawdling. Push through: the sea can have whoever is left.

description.good: A one-way track through the reserve. The herds are migrating, the elephants have right of way and the hippos are not friendly. Drive kindly.
description.evil: Wildebeest on the road, elephants flattening tourists, hippos charging out of the river. At last, a place that drives the way you do.

description.good: The airport is having a very bad day. Tankers, hangars and an airliner are coming down on the perimeter road: deliver between the blasts.
description.evil: Everything at the airport is exploding and none of it is your fault, yet. Thread the wreckage and add to the insurance claim.

description.good: Through a working building site: mud, trenches, machines on the move and portaloos that dance. Hard hat on, and leave the bad petrol alone.
description.evil: Diggers swinging, sewage everywhere, portaloos dancing in the road. Knock over what you can: the mud will hide the evidence.

description.good: A delivery through a rough neighbourhood. Gang houses shoot at whatever passes and drive-by cars cruise: take the armour and keep moving.
description.evil: Gang houses, drive-bys and bullets for anyone passing. They started it. Grab the armour and give the street something back.

description.good: A long highway through the bush. Kangaroos cross without looking, semis thunder by and drop bears wait in the trees. Keep moving.
description.evil: An empty highway, big trucks, bouncing wildlife and drop bears overhead. Out here nobody can hear the horn.

description.good: The limit is 100 and ten cameras are counting: round the shops, over the hill, in the fog. Ease off for each, or let the radar detector earn its keep.
description.evil: Ten speed cameras, three jams to fly over and a getaway driver showing how it is done. Knock the cameras flat, or just smile for the photo.

description.good: Over the pass in winter: ice on the bends, black ice in the shade, rocks off the walls and fog at the summit roadworks. Cut no corners; the clock is fragile.
description.evil: A loose cannonball, four icy hairpins and half the mountain coming down. Cut every corner, squeeze past the roadworks and let the fog hide the rest.

description.good: Dingo Flat roadhouse to the railhead: four crossings, a grain siding at each, a pub in the S, roos in the Emu Creek floodway. The train always wins.
description.evil: Bells ringing, booms coming down, a wheat train due, a twenty lying just past the rails. You can make it. Probably. Leave the ruts to the caravans.

description.good: Blasting day at the quarry. Mind the stop / go men, creep through the mud, duck the low bridge or take the haul road, and heed the sirens.
description.evil: Sirens, blasts, boulders in the lanes, dump trucks crossing. Run the stop boards, wade the ford and be the second most dangerous thing in the quarry.

description.good: The harbour front by night, on the left: roadworks, cameras, fresh tar, the long tunnel, the sea over the low road, a second tunnel and home.
description.evil: Taxis nose to tail, four cameras to ignore, wet tar, two tunnels and the harbour washing over the road. The best money is in the tram lane.

description.good: An expressway with rules: an 80 limit, a lane that reverses, a police roadblock and trucks shedding their loads. Kei trucks set the pace.
description.evil: Tunnels, cameras, a roadblock and a lane about to fill with oncoming cars. The kei trucks are in for a memorable commute.

description.good: Monsoon season. Rickshaws swarm, water mains burst through the road, a parade fills the street and cows go where they please. Be kind.
description.evil: Rickshaws, potholes, geysers in the road and a parade with nowhere to hide. The monsoon is the least of their problems.

description.good: The last round before Christmas, in a gale that lifts cars off the road. Icy streets, post vans, an ice-cream van out of season. Deliver the joy.
description.evil: Snow, ice and a street of last-minute shoppers queuing behind an ice-cream van. Somebody is getting coal, and it is arriving at speed.

description.good: Five film sets in one street: mind the cattle, the crew and the pyrotechnics, and get the trophy to its winner before the director calls cut.
description.evil: Stampede through the Western, buzz the spaceship, blow through New York. Every take is a stunt, and the alien in the back is nearly awake.

description.good: A gelato run down the quay: hop three humped bridges, jump the drawbridge, ease past the carnival and keep it dry when the tide comes in.
description.evil: A haunted mirror for a palazzo. Scatter the carnival, fly the bridges, and let the acqua alta take anyone too slow along the quay.

description.good: A snow globe across the frozen lake under the northern lights. Easy on the glare ice, hold your line in the wind, and give the trucks room.
description.evil: A block of ice that must not thaw, a lake of glare ice, and truck convoys to bully. Take the ridge flat out and let the wind sort the rest.

description.good: A bunch of balloons through the park on its busiest day: mind the parade, the fun run and the park train, and smile for the rollercoaster.
description.evil: A jack-in-the-box, wound tight, through a park full of queues: scatter the fun run, gatecrash the parade and fly both crests.

description.good: A lava lamp for the far side of the island: up the mountain and down, gently over the drawbridge, and do watch for falling rocks.
description.evil: A pressure cooker across an island that is already boiling: geysers, lava bombs and a drawbridge over the lava. Jump it.

description.good: A globe to the far end of the terminal: keep clear of the cranes and the forklifts, stop for the trains, and mind the 60 limit.
description.evil: A leaking barrel through the docks: beat the trains, jump the bridge, and grab the cash under the stack before it comes down.

description.good: A cactus for the far end of the territory. Mind the cattle on Main Street and the train at the crossing, and tip your hat to the sheriff.
description.evil: A sack of snakes, six towns to scare. Scatter the herd down Main Street, fly the gulch and race the posse to the mine. This road ain't big enough.

description.good: A sushi boat for the village below the terraces. Up to the temple gate, then down the steps of the hill: mind the buffalo, the tractors and the ford.
description.evil: A cage of bats, a thousand paddies. Scatter the buffalo, jump the ridge, slide the hairpins through the spill and take the ford at full tilt.

description.good: A four-lane slot track round the playroom, and two wind-up racers want your tip. Thread the bumps, hop the queue by the ramp and be first to the toy box.
description.evil: Two clockwork couriers think this is their track. Fly the ramp over the traffic jam, flatten the farm set and leave them both under the bulldozer.

description.good: A quake has shaken the tunnel: roof falls, buckled plates and a jam behind each. Go round the rubble, ease over the bumps and mind the wet tar.
description.evil: The sea bed is shaking and everyone has stopped to look. Take the transporter's ramps over the jam and the big notes from under the falling roof.

description.good: The long haul to the far-side observatory: washboard dust, rover ruts, switchbacks and a meteor storm. Pick a rut, hold it, and keep the telescope level.
description.evil: Nobody can see the far side from Earth. Rattle over the washboard flat out, jump the queue off the transporter and race the meteors to the last crater rim.

description.good: Stunt day on the one-way backlot: rain machines, a ramp over the jam, a plane coming down and extras on parade. Coffees to the director, none spilt.
description.evil: They are filming the big chase and you were not cast. Jump the queue, jump the drawbridge, drive through the explosion and steal the whole scene.

description.good: The back alleys: seven humped bridges to hop, cobbles, wet paint and the bora off the lagoon. Fly each bridge straight and keep the tea set in one piece.
description.evil: Seven bridges and a goose with a grudge. Skim the cobbles flat out, take the big notes off the wet tar and the quayside, and land every jump.

description.good: A telescope for the night watchman, after closing. One way round the service road: thread the speed humps, mind the forklifts and duck the coaster.
description.evil: A mimic chest through a park with nobody left to scream. Fly the ride transporter over the queue, plough the fresh tar and lose security in the ghost train.

description.good: A canary to the last boat out. The mountain has gone up: keep with the evacuation, mind the cattle on the road, and watch the sky for lava bombs.
description.evil: An egg that likes the heat, through an island on the run. Fly the jam off the transporter, rattle over the washboard, and let the lava bombs sort out the queue.

description.good: A bonsai out of the exclusion zone. Through the checkpoint, past the plant's cooling towers and the dead village: keep out of the green, off the glowing cars.
description.evil: A cloud for a client who glows in the dark. Run the hot stretches flat out, thread the infected traffic for the cash, and let the armour take the dose.

description.good: A tea set across the rainy valley. Keep left, hold the ruts, mind the spray off the lorries and the frogs, and take each ford or its bridge.
description.evil: Piranhas for a flooded valley. Take the fords flat out, hide in the lorries' spray and let the cattle stampede sort out the queue.

description.good: Pancakes for the trail crew, still warm. Beat the train to both crossings, pick a wagon rut and keep to it, and take the bridge if the ford looks deep.
description.evil: A cannonball for the cattle baron. Split the herds, race the train, wade the ford and duck the old trestle: the trail is long and the fuse is not.

description.good: The lake road in the thaw, by day: slush ruts, rippled ice, spray off the lorries and a meltwater ford. Pick a rut, skim the ripples, or take the bridge.
description.evil: The ice is going and so is everyone's nerve. Fly the jam off the transporter, wade the ford for the big notes and leave the lorries blind in your spray.

description.good: A hearse, a road through the underworld, and every single car coming straight at you. Down here you are the good one. Deliver anyway.
Your delivery van is a flying saucer and the road runs through asteroid fields. Chain the ghost pickups and glide through the rocks.
description.evil: A saucer, three asteroid fields and no traffic police for light years. Catch each ghost before the last one fades, or the rocks win.

description.good: Three laps of the street circuit under the lights. The walls bite, the pack does not wait, and wrenches are the only help. Race clean.
description.evil: Three laps between concrete walls with a full grid to lean on. No packages here: use the car. Less time, more elbows.

description.good: By jetboat through a minefield, three hundred and more of them, some adrift. The trawlers are working: go round, gently, wake and all.
description.evil: A jetboat, a sea full of mines and trawlers too slow to get out of the way. Something is going to go bang, and you are steering.

description.good: Three laps of the island circuit: long straights, hard stops and walls close on the exits. Brake early, pass cleanly, finish in time.
description.evil: Long straights, big braking zones and a wall at every exit. Brake late, lean on whoever is alongside, and let the wall have them.

description.good: Two laps of the Mountain: up the hill, across the top between the walls, and flat out down the other side. Treat it with respect.
description.evil: Two laps up and over the Mountain. The walls across the top are close enough to post somebody into. Do.

description.good: Another courier is after the same tip, and playing dirty. Beat them to the drop through the tractors and bales, fair and square.
description.evil: A goody-two-shoes courier wants your tip. Farm lanes, tractors, a Big Splash pickup: make sure only one of you arrives.

description.good: Night, a little roadster, and three evil couriers racing you to the drop. Every one that gets there first takes a share of the tip.
description.evil: Three rival villains, one tip, one dark road. They are every bit as bad as you are: be worse, and be first.

description.good: Two armies at war along the road, and your 8x8 rolls with the green one. Mines, pillboxes, tanks head-on: the bigger vehicle wins. Get through.
Down the slipway and across the bay, twice. Your car floats: steer round the pedal boats and the barge, and wave at the balloon.
description.evil: Beach traffic queues at the water's edge while you drive straight in. The pedal boats make excellent speed bumps.

description.good: Three crossings of the harbour among ferries and barges, with a tunnel and potholed streets in between. Keep left, afloat or not.
description.evil: Ferries, barges and dinghies, all slower than you would like. Leave a wake across the harbour and the potholes for everyone else.

description.good: The city is under water. Four flooded stretches to float across, burst mains, loose trolleys, falling containers. Somebody still needs their parcel.
description.evil: A flooded city, traffic stranded at every waterline, and you sailing past in a car. Rub it in. Mind the falling containers.

description.good: Five river crossings on safari. The hippos live here and the elephants are passing through: float quietly and give them the river.
description.evil: Five fords, a river full of hippos and elephants on the bank. Whatever they flatten is one less car in your way.

description.good: Across the fjord and back among the ferries, then ice, rockfall and a tunnel on the far shore. Cold water, warm heart, dry parcel.
description.evil: A ferry to cut up, ice to slide on, rocks coming down and fog to do it all in. Nobody will see a thing.

description.good: Three laps of the temple of speed with thirty-nine others. Flat out, then the chicanes: miss one and the gravel keeps you.
description.evil: Thirty-nine cars into the first chicane, and less time than any of them. Out-brake the lot: the gravel will catch whoever you push.

description.good: Two laps, seven kilometres each, through the forest and over the hills. Smooth through the fast sweeps and stay out of the gravel.
description.evil: Seven kilometres a lap of fast bends with gravel waiting on the outside. Put somebody in it at every corner.

description.good: Three laps round the lake in the park. Quick, flowing and lined with walls: keep it tidy and bring the car home.
description.evil: A lap of the lake, three times, with walls on both sides and a grid in between. Shove first, apologise never.

description.good: Coffees for the night crew at the far gate: the terminal after dark, on the left, in fog. Spray, fresh tar and a height bar (the side road goes round).
description.evil: A reactor core through the yard with half the lights out. Fly the jam off the transporter, plough the fresh tar and leave the lorries blind in your spray.

description.good: A bouquet for the wedding at the foot of the hill, down nine hairpins in the rain. Spray, mud, falling rocks and a lane washed away.
description.evil: A thundercloud in a jar, down the hill in a storm of its own. Nine hairpins, a landslide, half the road gone: never brake.

description.good: A goldfish across the smallest town on the map: speed humps, the high street, market day, the level crossing by the park. Small car, small streets, four corners, no time to dawdle.
description.evil: A porcupine loose in a toy-sized town. Trolleys across the high street, café tables in the square, an ice-cream van in your lane and a train to beat: tiny car, big trouble.

description.good: A midsummer cake along the coast with the top down: through the bush, over the headland in one leap, across the Sea Cliff Bridge in the wind and into the bay with the sun in your eyes.
description.evil: A box of angry bees on the longest day. Leap the headland, ride the gusts on the cliff bridge, and let the low sun hide you from the patrol cars on the way into town.

description.good: A trophy up the capital's grandest avenue, in something long and heavy: sweeping bends, a wide load on the lake bridge, a lane that turns against you, and a car transporter to fly at the end.
description.evil: A briefcase of lawyers down the boulevard to Parliament. Shove past the wide load, take the reversible lane before it flips, outrun the pursuits and jump the jam on the ramp.

description.good: A globe for the harbour master, flat out down the container quay: a slalom of barriers through the S-bends, a freight train at the crossing, the tunnel under the stacks and a crane dropping its load at the end.
description.evil: A crate of fireworks through a port full of semis. Thread the barrier chicane, beat the container train, and let the cranes rain boxes on everyone behind you.

description.good: A lava lamp across the city at night, low and fast under the neon: fresh tar, the tunnel, a police roadblock to slip through, a lane that turns against you and the wind on the high span.
description.evil: A sack of glitter on the expressway after dark. Grab the siren before the roadblock, beat the reversible lane and leave the keitrucks sparkling.

description.good: Coffee for the night shift, the race-day way: out past the grandstands and the pits, through the hay-bale chicane and the squeeze on the long straight, a rival courier on your tail all the way to the line.
description.evil: An air horn for the drivers who are trying to sleep. Race Le Comte down the long straight, cut the chicanes, scatter the kangaroos and the caravans, and beat him to the line.

description.good: A carved pumpkin for the harvest ball. Through the fog, past the graveyard gates and the ghost cars, under the haunted hill and home by lantern light.
description.evil: A cage of bats for the old house on the hill. Smash the pumpkin crates, fly the humpback bridge, race the ghost train and drive through the ghost cars.

description.good: Pumpkin pie for the church supper, over the hills at peak colour. Ease off on the wet leaves, mind the covered bridge and the pumpkin crates.
description.evil: Maple syrup, stolen, with the whole county after it. Skid the wet leaves, hit the covered bridge flat out and flatten the pumpkin stands.

description.good: A case of Chianti for the harvest table. Ease the tractors round the hairpins, take the old humpback bridges gently and beat the train to the crossing.
description.evil: A stolen marble bust, and it knows. Slingshot the hairpins, fly the humpbacks, scatter the cows and leave the tractors weeping in the vines. Beat the train.

description.good: Water jugs for the rally camps, a dust-and-dune stage: the wind will shove you off the ridge, the crests will throw you, and two rival couriers want the finish.
description.evil: A crate of scarabs across the dunes. Let the crosswinds blow the tall ones into the sand, fly the crests flat out and leave two rivals eating your dust.

description.good: A fruit basket for the ranger station at the end of the jungle road. Splash the fords, cross two creaking bridges and give the elephants right of way.
description.evil: A sack of snakes, smuggled out through the rainforest. Hit the fords flat out, jump the mud, scatter the elephants and let the rain wash out your tracks.

description.good: Bubble teas for the food court, before the doors open. The floors are freshly mopped, the trolleys are loose, and the loading dock is the only way out.
description.evil: A hamster in a ball for the pet shop, and it wants out. Skate the mopped halls flat out, scatter the trolleys and go out through the loading dock.

description.good: Coffee for the road crew at the far end of the works. Follow the cones: a lane closed, the lanes shifted, then a contraflow. Keep to the limit.
description.evil: A bucket of glitter for the fresh tarmac. Clip the cones, cut the tapers fine and squeeze past the queue before the contraflow.

description.good: Late coffee for the night shift. Follow the arrow boards and the yellow lines: a lane closed, the lanes shifted, then a contraflow under the lights.
description.evil: Glitter for the night shift's fresh tarmac. Cut the tapers in the dark, clip the cones and race the queue to the contraflow.

description.good: Horseshoes for the farrier, straight off the line. Through the melt shop and the rolling mill: wait for the ingot trains, and keep out from under the ladles.
description.evil: A bar of gold that is mostly not gold. Beat the ingot trains to the crossings, ride the conveyors flat out and be gone before the gilt peels.

description.good: The night shift's horseshoes. The furnaces glow in the dark: mind the ingot trains and the ladles pouring on the road.
description.evil: Questionable gold, by the light of the furnaces. Race the ingot trains, ride the conveyors and keep it out of the light.

description.good: Poker chips for the cashier's cage at the far end of the Strip. Three jams, three ramps: ride the walkway, hit the ramp, or take the long way round.
description.evil: Counterfeit chips, a dye pack in the lid. Hit every walkway and jump every jam. Double or nothing, all the way down the Strip.

description.good: Chips for the late shift at the cage. The Strip is lit up, the fountains are dancing and the jams are back: jump them or go round.
description.evil: Counterfeit chips under the neon. Walkway, ramp, over the queue, three times. The house always wins. Prove it wrong.

description.good: A wheel of mountain cheese for the hut at the col. Mind the cows in the meadow, the black ice in the shade and the rocks over the hairpins.
description.evil: A fondue of no known cheese, boiling over. Scatter the cows, take the shade flat out and race the rockfall up to the snow.

description.good: Ticket rolls for the depot. One lane between two tracks; pillars block the lane, so swerve onto whichever track has no train.
description.evil: Tunnel rats for the depot. The cash is on the tracks, and so are the trains. Pillars in the lane: pick a track or wreck.
